todos: [P2] FULLTASK-RELIABILITY-01: FULLTASK-BEHAVIORAL-CLOSURE-01 is closed (2026-09-24): scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b reached completionStatus 'verified' in runs 15, 17 and 22 (8/8 in 28 and 34 steps, build first, then npm test). The closure is not yet reliable: of runs 17-26 after the fixes, 2 closed verified. Failure classes, each seen once, all addressed in code but not yet rerun: run 24 the model called ask about dependency versions and AUTO mode ended the run (fixed 2026-09-24: AUTO answers version questions from the npm registry and the manifest, versionQuestion.ts and AgentToolExecutorService.answerVersionQuestion, sharing the ask redirect budget); run 26 Vitest 0.26 printed only chai's one-line message with a truncated received value (fixed: expected/received read from that message, testedModuleText fallback); run 25 a CssSyntaxError under [plugin vite:css] (now diagnosed); run 21 the auto-matched tailwind-css-v4 skill contradicted a tailwindcss ^3 manifest (fixed: skillVersionFit.ts). Next, on Windows with Ollama, rerun npm run test:live (fullTaskRun.live.ts) until at least 3 of 5 runs close verified, reading the new coding_agent_audit.unredacted.log of each snapshot.

[P2] GPTOSS-FULLTASK-01: gpt-oss:20b plans and runs the full task (GPTOSS-PLAN-JSON-01 fixed: structured requests of level-only models send think 'low') but still ends 0/10. Fixed on 2026-09-24: shell reads run as read_file (shellFileRead.ts), every turn exposing run_command also exposes read_file, skills named <package>-v<major> leave the prompt once the manifest declares another major, and (after run 5) read_file on a directory lists it and read_file on a missing file returns [FILE NOT FOUND: …] with the parent directory listing as a result, not an execution failure (readFileTool.ts), so run 5's stop at step 15 on the execution recovery budget cannot recur that way. Open, not yet rerun: the model re-reads every file right after writing it (run 5 steps 2, 5, 9, 12); run 4 ended at step 41 on 'Ollama chat stream stalled: no tokens received for 30s' twice while the fast test suite was running on the same machine. Next, rerun with ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL=gpt-oss:20b on an idle Windows machine with Ollama and classify the next stop.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: since 2026-09-24 agent log entries may carry `localized` (message keys plus parameters, nested or verbatim lines; shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, whose AGENT_MAIN_TEXT_IT is also the renderer's `agentMain` Italian locale) and the timeline renders them in the UI language (localizeAgentLog); the application closure summary is migrated. Still Italian only in the UI: the closure reason (ApplicationClosureRequest.reason is free text from about 15 guard call sites, e.g. 'Il modello richiede una decisione dell'utente prima di proseguire.'), the 'Diagnostica sessione' detail (renderDiagnosticDetail), the agent:done summary kept in executed prompts, about 70 other emitLog messages (agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts, agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts, agentOrchestratorAskAutoHealing.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...', and the session tracker markdown (sessionDebtTracker.ts). The Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give ApplicationClosureRequest a reason key for the guard call sites, then migrate the diagnostic detail and the agent:done summary (AgentDoneResult.localized), and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists. Open question for the user before extending it: confirm that the next slices reuse the same `localized` field of agent:log (additive, optional) and add AgentDoneResult.localized.

[P3] TEST-PLATFORM-01: the fast suite is verified on Windows only. On Linux (cloud container, no PowerShell, 2026-09-24) 35 tests in 16 files fail before and after every change: PersistentPowerShellSession, TaskRunner and the run_command/run_tests paths that spawn PowerShell (timeouts or success false), Windows path expectations (projectRegistryDomain deriveNameFromPath with 'D:\Projects\Alpha', contextFilter and agentOrchestratorSessionSetup protected directories, structuredCommandSafety), hardware-derived num_ctx (agentInterviewAppService, planGenerationAppService expect 8192, the container resolves 4096) and a 5 s timeout in tokenEstimate cache bounds. Next, decide whether these tests should inject the platform, hardware profile and shell (so they run everywhere) or declare themselves Windows-only with a visible reason; never skip them silently.
